See AMC.570, AMC.603 (a) and AMC.603 (b)
(a) Fatigue and damage tolerance demonstration shall depend on the predicted life time, usage spectrum and maintenance philosophy of the UAV System for which certification is requested.
(b) For UAV Systems for which certification is requested for very short life time (less than 5 cycles)
  (1) static strength demonstration using ultimate loads, see USAR.305(b), is required, and,
  (2) USAR.572 to USAR.575 may not be applicable however this must be agreed with the Certifying Authority.
(c) For other UAV Systems, fatigue and damage tolerance analysis must be carried out. The demonstration level and exhaustivity shall be adapted to predicted life time using USAR.572 to USAR.575. Consideration shall be given to fatigue monitoring, in agreement with the Certifying Authority.
(d) The requirements of USAR.570 are applicable for both metallic or composite structures.

See AMC.U570, AMC.603 (a) and AMC 20-29
(a) Fatigue and damage tolerance demonstration shall depend on the predicted life time, usage spectrum (see USAR.U17) and maintenance philosophy of the UAS for which certification is requested.
(b) For UAS for which certification is requested for very short life time (less than 5 cycles)
  (1) static strength demonstration using ultimate loads, see USAR.305(b), is required, and
  (2) USAR.572 to USAR.575 may not be applicable however this must be agreed with the Certifying Authority.
(c) For other UAS, fatigue and damage tolerance analysis must be carried out.
  (1) The demonstration level and exhaustivity shall be adapted to predicted life time using USAR.572 to USAR.575
  (2) Consideration shall be given to fatigue monitoring, in agreement with the Certifying Authority.
(d) The requirements of USAR.U570 are applicable for either metallic or composite structures.
